differences:
Both sets are complete: 50 views each, the same names as director/final. Each view keeps its native size (960x640 or 1920x1080), and every size was checked against the overhaul shot. Views shot only at 1080p are saved twice, as <view>.png and <view>__1080.png, as in final/. contact.png shows vanilla | landed. contact_framing.png adds the overhaul as a third column, and I checked all 50 rows by eye: the framing matches.

Differences between vanilla and our captures (full list in ref/NOTES.md):
(1) Lighting and shadows: vanilla 3.05 has one lighting model and draws its default projected shadows with shadow maps off; it has no player setting for them. Landed is triSetLighting "remastered", which turns shadow maps on.
(2) Gamma: vanilla triScreenshot reads the frame before the gamma pass, so the collector applies the engine's pow(c,1/1.2) offline. 1.2 is the default gamma in both engines. On the Eden views the corrected means are within 1.5 levels of our build's features-off presented shots. Vanilla also captures the frame before the statement and ours the next one, so moving things can differ by one frame.
(3) Optics: the fork's look_director_optics shots are taken inside a forEach at present, so each lands one frame late. The final set's optics_mist_hud is really the first GUNNER frame (the iron sight), not the on-foot HUD. Vanilla is remapped so each file shows the same frame: hud is gun_f1, sight_f1 is gun_f2, sight is gun_f30. Vanilla's real on-foot HUD shot is kept in ref/extra/.
(4) Object detail: vanilla's stays adaptive and there is no settle check; a fixed wait of about 690 frames per view stands in for both.
(5) Clouds: vanilla has no cloud pin; the sim clock is still re-pinned before each shot.
(6) Street lamps: vanilla setDate does not switch them, so capPinEnv runs setDate, skipTime 0.01, setDate. The night views have their lamps lit.
(7) Sinai: vanilla uses the shadow's @LoBo without its Bin folder (details under problems). The props are the same LoBo classes on both sides, and the buildings load because vanilla 3.05 already has the 4WVR seekg fix.
(8) Firefight: the flashes and smoke depend on AI timing.
(9) No GPU timings or scene stats in the vanilla logs.

Landed side: each view is shot once in remastered mode. The Classic blocks are dropped, so each landed shot comes after a shorter wait on the view than the director's overhaul shots, which followed a Classic shot. The 1080p tests were generated over all views and then cut into chunks of five, so every view keeps its look_final sim clock. Landed logged UNSETTLED:300 on the 960 town_night, firefight and sinai_lowsun_fp views (the draw count kept moving).

Test files: vanilla tests, capture_lib.sqf, missions and the runner are in D:/Arma_CWA_worktrees/vanilla-upstream/tests/rendering/captures/. Landed tests are the ref_landed_* files in D:/Arma_CWA_worktrees/look-ref/arma_CWR/tests/rendering/captures/ (look-ref is a detached copy of fec1075 with base.patch, nothing built there). The scripts that make the tests and collect the shots are in ref/tools/.
problems:
(1) Vanilla 3.05 cannot boot any mission, even the Eden one, with the shadow's @LoBo mounted as is. In vanilla a mod's Bin/config.cpp replaces the whole base config, and in the shadow that file is UD's generated Guerrilla faction table, written for the fork's deferred config merge (log: "No class BulletBurstW", "StartAutoTest could not boot"). The first vanilla Sinai attempt failed that way. I worked around it with D:/Arma_CWA_worktrees/vanilla-upstream/tmp/lobo-mods/@LoBo, which holds junctions to the shadow's @LoBo/addons and @LoBo/dta and no Bin. The faction table draws nothing.

(2) Those junctions point into the shared Remaster shadow. Remove them only with cmd /c rmdir; PowerShell 5.1 Remove-Item -Recurse would empty the shadow's folders.

(3) The fork's optics test has a capture-timing quirk: its "hud" shot is actually the first sight frame. The vanilla files were remapped to match, but anyone reading the final set should know optics_mist_hud does not show the on-foot HUD.

(4) There is no proof that the vanilla views finished loading, because vanilla has no scene stats; it rests on the long wait and an eye check.

Housekeeping: only my own games were stopped, with stop-owned-games on the junctions RemasterUD-landed, RemasterUD-vanilla and RemasterUD-vanprobe, plus my own tri process for the failed Sinai run. No branches, commits or engine edits.
